instruction: You are given a backward-facing-step template `/home/user/Desktop/bfs_base/`. Complete a turbulent separation and reattachment analysis from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/bfs/`: - Build the backward-facing-step geometry (inlet section, step, downstream expansion section) - Set the turbulence model and inflow conditions - Configure wall boundary conditions 2. Run the solver to convergence. 3. Extract downstream wall pressure distribution and verify the presence of a separation bubble (negative-pressure region). 4. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Minimum pressure coefficient on the downstream wall `min_cp` - Format: `min_cp` 5. Do not use GUI tools. [Software] OpenFOAM is normally used from a shell after sourcing your installation environment (e.g. its `etc/bashrc`); `foamRun -help` verifies solver binaries are available.
